procedure: Exported the lab files of the named commit with git archive into uncommitted private staging outside the repository, with an empty local Maven repository.

Ran the setup command mvn -q dependency:go-offline in starter/ (the one network step), then the shipped starter with mvn -q -o test: it exited 1 and failed exactly the declared failingTests (5 tests, 5 failures, 0 errors).

Deleted starter/target, then replaced only the learner-edited file (starter/src/main/java/workshops/WorkshopController.java) with privately staged completed work; a recursive diff against a second git archive of the commit showed every other file byte-identical.
Ran the test command mvn -q -o test offline against the staged completion.
result: mvn -q -o test exited 0 with no output; the surefire report workshops.WorkshopApiTest.txt reads Tests run: 5, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, matching expected/test-summary.txt.
starterRun: On the shipped starter, mvn -q -o test exits 1 with Tests run: 5, Failures: 5, Errors: 0, failing exactly the declared failingTests (checked in the same run sequence from the surefire XML report).
cleanup: The runs created only starter/target inside the lab; after the documented cleanup removed it, the only difference from the exported commit was the privately staged learner file.
otherSystems: Linux and Windows runs are not yet recorded; hosted CI is currently disabled, so this macOS record is the only execution evidence (lab-contract section 10).
testScope: The public tests check only HTTP status codes, headers and JSON bodies over MockMvc for the listed inputs; they do not check which Java constructs the code uses.
variantRuns: Single-lab run: this lab alone was proven against its own empty local Maven repository; its setup command supplied everything the offline test needed.
